atoms.text: Leo says: “Today my tennis coach was angry with me because I didn't listen to him when he explained the task. I didn't concentrate because I was thinking about meeting Vanessa tomorrow. I felt really sad when the coach was angry. I told him why I didn't listen. Then he was no longer angry because he could understand.”

atoms.text: Kelly says: “Last week, Jack and I talked about a football camp in summer. I asked Jack if he wants to come with me to the camp, but he doesn't like football, so he doesn't want to come with me. I was very sad because now I don't know anyone from the football camp. But I can't change his mind.”

atoms.text: Joshua says: “Yesterday, I talked to my mother about her birthday. I asked her what she wants to do at the weekend to celebrate. She said that she just wants to have dinner together at home. At first, I thought it was strange because it's nothing special. Anyway, now I understand her, because she just wants to spend time with her family.”
